title: ACA s. 87 — Effect of arbitral and related court proceedings commenced prior to 23rd October, 2015

content.overview: Section 87 was inserted in 2019 to prescribe a transitional rule for the 2015 amendments. The Supreme Court in Hindustan Construction Company Ltd. v. Union of India struck section 87 down as unconstitutional. Accordingly, section 87 must be treated as a historical provision and not as the current governing transitional rule.
content.glance: Section 87 was inserted in 2019 to prescribe a transitional rule for the 2015 amendments. The Supreme Court in Hindustan Construction Company Ltd. v. Union of India struck section 87 down as unconstitutional. Accordingly, section 87 must be treated as a historical provision and not as the current governing transitional rule.
content.study:
Historical statutory rule: Section 87 purported to determine the temporal application of the 2015 amendments to arbitral proceedings and related court proceedings.

Current legal status: The Supreme Court struck down section 87 in Hindustan Construction Company Ltd. v. Union of India. It is therefore not the operative transitional rule.
